Who We Are

Nigeria's Home of Quality Bicycles

Implex Bicycle World is Jos and Plateau State's most trusted bicycle dealer. We stock a wide range of bicycles — from powerful E-bikes and rugged Mountain Bikes to fun Kids Bikes, sleek City bikes, and compact Mini bikes.

Located at High Tension, Ramun Gyel (New Abuja), Jos, we've built our reputation on selling 100% genuine bikes at honest prices, backed by real customer service you can reach on WhatsApp anytime.

Whether you're commuting, training, or buying your child their first bike — Implex is your one-stop bicycle shop. We also offer repairs, wheel alignment, bike wash, and bicycle hire.

AffordabilityPremium bikes that respect your budget
QualityGenuine products, zero compromises
ServiceWhatsApp-first, always responsive

Our Mission

To put every Nigerian on a quality bicycle — making transport, fitness and fun accessible to all, one ride at a time.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I place an order? +

Click any "Order on WhatsApp" button or message us at 08104562647. Tell us the bike, your location — we'll handle the rest including delivery!

Do you deliver nationwide? +

Yes! We deliver to all 36 states. You can also visit our showroom in Jos. Shipping fees vary — chat us on WhatsApp for your exact delivery cost.

Are the bikes original and genuine? +

Absolutely. Every bicycle is 100% genuine, sourced from certified manufacturers. All new bikes come with a warranty.

Can I test ride before buying? +

Yes! Visit our showroom at High Tension, Ramun Gyel (New Abuja), Jos and test ride any bike in our collection before purchase.

Do you repair bikes not bought from you? +

Yes! We offer bicycle repairs, wheel alignment, and bike wash for all brands. Bring your bike in or chat us on WhatsApp first.
